gate.rule: MCC must not decrease and at least one of BACC/AUROC/AUPRC must improve

frozen_prott5_fusion.reason: It improves the previous full2795 structure fusion ranking slightly but remains below the pilot250 multidimensional default MCC/AUROC/AUPRC 0.86935/0.97730/0.95360.

source_analysis.interpretation: The class-threshold gain is concentrated in the short PepFlow cohort; AF2 mainly contributes very small ranking/calibration changes.

limitations: This is group-aware training OOF evidence, not an untouched independent test.
The improvements are small and concern probability ranking; the fixed-threshold full-cohort confusion matrix is unchanged.

The effect is sparse: the covered-cohort median absolute probability change is 1.20e-7, the 99th percentile is 0.0131, and the maximum is 0.2787, so the gain must be checked for outlier stability on new data.
PepFlow and AF2 outputs are generator samples or predictions, not experimentally measured thermodynamic populations.
Samples outside the 11-30 aa covered cohorts have an exactly zero new residual.
